sections.title: authority-manifest.v1.json
sections.content: Defines repository, lifecycle, knowledge, implementation, acceptance, and consumer-policy authority sources; identifies requirements, implementation contract, command registry, terminal validator, persisted run owner, lifecycle projections, and authorizes=[]。

sections.title: command-registry.v1.json
sections.content: Registers R0-R4 green and terminal commands plus quick-dev, acceptance, and full-terminal suites. Commands run from the repository with bounded timeouts; registry authorizes=[]。

sections.title: implementation-contract.v1.json
sections.content: Self-hosted repair plan for acceptance-coordinator trust recovery. Defines R0 trusted evidence, R1 successor recovery, R2 authorization and freshness continuity, R3 legacy RED verification, R4 read-only dogfood, slice dependencies, write sets, forbidden paths, and terminal predicate.

sections.title: repair/round-1/finding-set.md
sections.content: Bounded repair covers terminal compatibility, receipt bindings, traceability, self-hosted authority declarations, immutable historical-plan protection, and RED-baseline contamination. Pre-existing shared workflow changes require separate disposition; repair closure remains absent pending validation and authority prerequisites.

sections.title: requirements-and-acceptance.md
sections.content: Requires persisted binding-derived acceptance execution, reentrant successor identity, authorization continuity, degraded same-selection knowledge refresh with hard blocks for authority or selection drift, guarded legacy RED reuse, and immutable historical dogfood replay. All transitions remain non-authorizing unless explicitly owned.

sections.title: tools/terminal_full.py
sections.content: Validator computes candidate and artifact hashes, runs registered slice or full commands, checks plan state, maintainer authorization, knowledge context and freeze consistency, skill-input receipt validation, terminal receipts, and non-authorizing lifecycle bindings. It emits slice-ready or implementation-complete results with authorizes=[].
